Name: Giant Crazy Mustache Gus in the Rain
Author: BleakCodex
Description:
[size=3]Laying in bed wondering why you were fated to live in a timeline where Gus is just.... Gus?[/size]


[size=3]Wondering who the lucky souls are that live in the splendor of a [b]7' 2''[/b] Gus with a [u]Mustache-span[/u] of [b]4 Feet[/b]?

Well, you tripped over a Monkey's Paw a couple days back, caught the attention of Djinn, and probably shouldn't've taken that  [i][font=Georgia]tchotchke[/font][font=Courier New] [/font][/i]the creepy man wouldn't take [i]'money' [/i]for.


[i][font=Courier New]Now we all have to live with this.


[/font][/i][/size]To Install, simply copy into your Mods Folder in your Stardew Valley installation directory.
